topic: What to say when your teen says 'I'm bored' (script included)
caption:
When your teen says 'I'm bored,' that's actually your opening.

Try this script: 'Want to earn $20 this weekend? I know how to help you start.'

Most teens just need someone to hand them a real first step, not a lecture.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
